about_the_game:
Meet Ricky in this thrilling retro 2D pixel style arcade game mixing flipper, brick-busting and fight. Have you got the skills... And the guts ?

Story mode

Beat your opponents and trigger mechanisms in a succession of narrative levels.

Play as Ricky, a young thug on the road to redemption, determined to pick up where he left off his education, in high school.

Discover an absurd epic that takes you into a gang war and to the discovery of a hallucinated educational system.

Arcade mode

Explode the bricks to advance to the next level. Activate the special balls and aim just right to destroy certain bricks before the effect wears off... Or try again!

Double Mode 2 players

  • In Challenge levels, the ball won't come out. Hit your ball to score points, and steal your opponent's to score even more, like a thug!

  • In Duel levels, the ball can come out, so send it back to your opponent in 3-point matches. Tennis? No, B-Ricky!

Put your precision to the test in fast-paced, nerve-racking games on the edge of pinball and brick-box. Try out the different game modes to score maximum points and unlock the next levels.

Let's be precise:

  • As in pinball (or tennis), choose between left and right strokes to direct the ball with precision. Or give in to panic and send the ball straight back, brick-busting style... at the cost of accuracy.

  • Discover a real sense of control by directing the ball's trajectory as you see fit... if you're up to it!

Action:

Move Ricky horizontally to hit the ball before it leaves the screen. Be quick and precise, as the speed of the ball increases.

Combos:

Trigger combos that double your points with each impact.

Balls to win:

You have 3 balls/tries to complete each table, no more, no less.

Big pixels for a tribute to traditional 16-bit games of my childhood.

Lovers of old-school games, this game was made for you.

Final word

B-Ricky High school is under development, with the ambition of offering, at the very least, a hundred levels in arcade mode.

I made B-RICKY on my own, putting my heart and soul into it. The game has been constantly polished and enriched to become the one you'll find here.

Support a young person who wants to make it on his own - Ricky's future is in your hands!
